title: 第1425章 超脱一击大自在玄天神剑第1424章 灭绝婉儿借出的至宝超脱级威能
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
第1425章超脱一击，大自在玄天神剑
无声无息——
李越手上多出了一颗混混沌沌的灰色雷珠。
其内伟力无比内敛，从外看去，甚至只会因为是一颗寻寻常常的珠子。
可实际上——
这灰色珠子内，却隐藏着足以重创半步超脱级存在、乃至于短时间将半步超脱级存在打落境界的恐怖伟力！
那是‘乾源一气九灭雷霆’！
轰隆——！
李越目光凌厉，没有任何犹豫，直接将手中的乾源一气雷珠激发！
这件一次性的半步超脱级至宝，顿时爆发出了足以让半步超脱级存在都畏惧的滔天伟力！
一道恐怖到极致、横贯无尽苍宇的灰色雷霆瞬间出现，如高天之上的无上雷龙，发出绝世咆哮，凶狠至极的向着黑袍身影狠狠撞去！
‘乾源一气九灭雷霆’所过之处，什么遮天巨手，瞬间动摧毁一空！
‘乾源一气九灭雷霆’看起来只有一道，可实际上拥有九道，处于不同维度层面中！
九道雷霆，便是九灭！
九灭之下，半步超脱也要重创！
“乾源一气九灭雷霆！”
“那一战之中，乾源一脉竟然没有将‘乾源一气雷珠’用尽！”
残破宫殿中，传出那位超脱者颇为吃惊的声音。
很显然这有些出乎他的意料。
当年——

乾源一脉拿出了为数不少的‘乾源一气雷珠’，他们魔星阁一脉的半步超脱级弟子，起码有上百位是死在乾源一气九灭雷霆之下！
此雷源于乾源一脉弟子炼器之时的产物。
配合乾源一脉的独门炼器手法而成，威力绝强。
“哼——！”
他冷哼一声。
一柄赤红如火的巨伞飞出了残破宫殿，挡在了黑袍身影前方。
不过赤红巨伞出现的瞬间——
立即就有一条条可怕的本源大道神链从无尽黑暗中延伸而出，缠绕其上！
隐隐之间——
李越看到遥远处，有一只冰冷无情的眼眸睁开，带着三千维度至高无上的意志！
轰隆——！
乾源一气九灭雷霆瞬间轰在赤红巨伞上！
同时可怕滔天的大道神链凶猛拉扯，巨伞中的伟力被急速吞噬！
砰——！
下一瞬——
这一件明显属于超脱级的至宝直接四分五裂，被本源大道神链扯碎！
不过尽管如此。
但李越那一道乾源一气九灭雷霆却被挡了下来。
“以一件超脱级至宝为代价，为他挡这一击？”
“真是大手笔！”

李越惊叹不已。
不愧是能够将乾源一脉差点灭绝的魔星阁一脉，底蕴就是可怕！
content_en:
Chapter 1425: A Transcendent Blow, the Great Zizai Xuantian Divine Sword
Silently——
A chaotic gray thunder bead appeared in Li Yue's hand.
Its inner power is extremely restrained, and from the outside, it may even look like an ordinary bead.
But actually——
Hidden within this gray bead is a terrifying power that is enough to seriously injure a half-step transcendental being, and even knock a half-step transcendental being off the realm in a short period of time!
That's 'Qianyuan Qi Nine Destroys Thunder'!
Boom——!
Li Yue's eyes were sharp and without any hesitation, he directly activated the Qianyuan Qi Thunder Bead in his hand!
This one-time half-step transcendental treasure suddenly exploded with monstrous power that would make even half-step transcendental beings fearful!
An extremely terrifying gray thunder that spanned the endless sky appeared instantly, like a supreme thunder dragon in the sky. It let out a peerless roar and slammed into the black-robed figure with extreme ferocity!
Wherever the 'Qianyuan Qi Nine Destroying Thunder' passed, the giant hand covering the sky was destroyed in an instant!
'Qianyuan Yiqi Nine Destroying Thunder' seems to have only one path, but in fact it has nine paths, located in different dimensions!
Nine thunders are nine annihilations!
Under the Nine Destructions, even half a step of detachment will result in severe damage!
"Qian Yuan can destroy the thunder nine times with one breath!"
"During that battle, the Qianyuan lineage did not use up all the 'Qianyuan Qi Thunder Beads'!"
In the dilapidated palace, the rather surprised voice of the transcendent person came out.
Obviously this was somewhat beyond his expectation.
Back then——
The Qianyuan lineage took out a large number of 'Qianyuan Yiqi Thunder Beads'. At least hundreds of the half-step transcendent disciples of their Demon Star Pavilion lineage died under the Qianyuan Yiqi Nine Destruction Thunder!
This thunder originated from the product of the disciples of Qianyuan's lineage when they were refining weapons.
It is made with the unique weapon refining techniques of Qianyuan lineage and is extremely powerful.
"Hmph——!"
He snorted coldly.
A giant umbrella as red as fire flew out of the dilapidated palace and stood in front of the black-robed figure.
But the moment the red giant umbrella appeared——
Immediately, there were terrifying chains of the Origin Avenue extending from the endless darkness and wrapping around it!
Faintly——
Li Yue saw a cold and ruthless eye opening in the distance, carrying the supreme will of three thousand dimensions!
Boom——!
Qian Yuan's nine-destroying thunder instantly hit the giant red umbrella!
At the same time, the terrifying and monstrous Dao Divine Chain pulled fiercely, and the power in the giant umbrella was quickly swallowed!
Bang--!
The next moment——
This treasure, which was obviously a transcendental treasure, was torn apart directly and was torn into pieces by the Divine Chain of the Origin Avenue!
But nevertheless.
But Li Yue's Qianyuan Qi Nine Destroying Thunder was blocked.
"At the cost of a transcendent treasure, block this blow for him?"
"What a generous act!"
Li Yue was amazed.
As expected of the Demon Star Pavilion lineage that could almost wipe out the Qianyuan lineage, its background is terrifying!
